details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: denial of service through quadratic runtime in the
     default-attribute lookup performed by storeAtts()
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-66046.patch: resolve whether an attribute is
       declared CDATA through the per-element defaultAttsNames hash table
       instead of a linear scan of defaultAtts in expat/lib/xmlparse.c
     - CVE-2026-66046
   * SECURITY UPDATE: out-of-bounds read of .attIndex in storeAtts() for
     parsers created by XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate()
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-76641.patch: make dtdCopy() create the
       defaultAttsNames entries with the size of NAME_AND_DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTE
       and carry the attribute index over in expat/lib/xmlparse.c
     - CVE-2026-76641
   * SECURITY UPDATE: malformed UTF-16 accepted because a high surrogate was
     not required to be followed by a low surrogate
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-93990.patch: reject a UTF-16 high surrogate
       whose second code unit is not a low surrogate in the little2_ and
       big2_ tokenizers in expat/lib/xmltok.c and expat/lib/xmltok_impl.c
     - CVE-2026-93990
